text: dsh-continue-all 是面向 DSH Web 的会话续跑插件，在侧栏提供“全部继续”入口。它扫描会话日志，筛选因意外退出而留下未结束轮次的会话，并显示确认对话框、最近六小时范围和较早会话选项。确认后逐个通过会话队列发送 continue，界面展示进度与失败结果。适合需要在重启后批量恢复中断工作的 DSH 网页用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-continue-all adds a sidebar action to find DSH Web sessions left open by an unexpected exit. Review recent or older candidates, then queue “continue” for each selected session and see its progress. No API key or external service is configured.
DSH 意外退出后，有没有办法一次继续所有被打断的会话？
想在网页侧栏找出没跑完的会话并批量恢复。
How can I resume all DSH sessions that were interrupted by a crash?
dsh-continue-all 的功能「批量继续中断会话」：点击网页侧栏的“全部继续”后，插件扫描存储日志并列出未结束或以 interrupted 结束的会话；用户确认后，它逐个排队发送 continue，并显示进度和失败状态。
dsh-continue-all 的功能「选择较早的中断会话」：确认界面默认仅选最近六小时内停止的会话；用户可勾选加入更早的候选，再启动批量续跑。

dsh-continue-all README · dsh-continue-all：DSH Web UI plugin: one sidebar entry continues every session whose turn was left open by an unexpected DSH exit.

When DSH is killed, crashes, or times out mid-turn, the turn stays open in the stored log. On the next resume the agent loop closes it as `interrupted`, and the session sits idle in the sidebar with a failure notice. The usual fix is to open each affected session and press Continue. This plugin does that in one step.

dsh-continue-all README · Install：Use the DSH plugin manager (Plugins → Add plugin) with the spec:

```
github:mkpoli/dsh-continue-all
```

Or install from the command line and add the bundle to the profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mkpoli/dsh-continue-all
```

Then add `"dsh-continue-all"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and restart `dsh web`.

A prebuilt tarball is attached to the release:

dsh-continue-all README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/mkpoli/dsh-continue-all/releases/latest/download/dsh-continue-all.tgz
```

For a local checkout, `link:/path/to/dsh-continue-all` works the same way.

dsh-continue-all README · Use：The sidebar footer shows **Continue all**. Clicking it scans stored sessions, then lists the ones that stopped mid-turn. Confirming sends the literal prompt `continue` to each session in turn, through the same session retention and `prompt(..., "queue")` path the composer uses. The dialog shows per-session progress and failures.

dsh-continue-all README · How detection works：The host half exposes `POST /api/continue-all/scan` on DSH's authenticated `/api` channel. It lists visible stored sessions and reads each stored log. A session qualifies when its tail ends inside an open turn, or when its last `turn/end` reason is `interrupted`. The response carries the time that turn stopped; the client uses it to separate the recent window from older sessions.

dsh-continue-all README · How detection works：The scan caches its answer per persistence revision, so later scans read only logs that changed since the previous one. The first scan after a restart reads every stored log and can take a while on a large history; the result is kept for the lifetime of the process. A warm scan starts shortly after the host loads, so the first click usually finds it finished.

dsh-continue-all README · How detection works：The client requires scan response version 2. After an update, restart `dsh web` once so the host and client halves match; until then the dialog reports that the host half is out of date instead of starting anything.

Sessions whose logs cannot be read are skipped and logged on the host.

dsh-continue-all README · Development：```sh
npm test
```

The host scan is split into a pure `tailDecision` predicate and a persistence reader, so the turn-boundary rules and stop times are tested without a live DSH.
